written.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
written.summary: Google DeepMind made its Genie 4 world model available as a research preview on Oct. 27, 2026. The model creates photorealistic, interactive simulations with real‑time audio and lets users edit scenes via text prompts for up to two minutes.
